title: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders

entities.name: Neyali
entities.description: A Mirran resistance cell leader and firebird keeper who surrenders herself to Slobad's trap to save her friend Reyana, and then leads the escape.

entities.name: Reyana
entities.description: An Auriok woman and Neyali's childhood friend, who raises firebirds and is shaken by her compleated mother; she goes willingly to Slobad seeking peace.

entities.name: Otharri
entities.description: Neyali's firebird, a phoenix who frees the caged Mirrans with his flame.

entities.name: Saheena
entities.description: An old one-eyed Vulshok woman and cell member with two sons, who stays with Neyali as honor guard.

entities.name: Elham
entities.description: An Auriok woman who led the cell before Neyali and carries heavy bags, with a golden prosthetic calf.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A goblin Phyrexian embedded in a golem-like Phyrexian body who runs the Salvage Complex and lures Mirrans with promises of reunion.

entities.name: Reyana's mother
entities.description: A compleated Auriok aspirant with a scythe arm who comes for Reyana and is thrown over a ledge by Neyali.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: The praetor of the Quiet Furnace who has insisted the Mirrans be left alone and sends obsolete Phyrexians to Slobad.

entities.name: Saheena's sons
entities.description: Two young Vulshok who accompany Saheena; one sees his father among Slobad's aspirants.

entities.name: Quiet Furnace
entities.description: Urabrask's layer of New Phyrexia where the resistance hides.

entities.name: Salvage Complex
entities.description: Slobad's prison-like complex with cages, an inverted ziggurat pit and rows of kneeling dead Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mirrex
entities.description: The ruined homeland where Neyali searched for survivors with Otharri.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: The resistance fighters who see phoenixes as a symbol of hope.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated rulers of the plane.

entities.name: Firebirds
entities.description: Fire-winged birds raised by the Mirrans as symbols of hope, seen as omens of death by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: The substance that compleates and corrupts the Mirrans.

events.summary: Neyali takes stock of her weary cell on the edge of the Quiet Furnace, recalling how she searched alone with Otharri before gathering them.
events.quote: Now, people depended on her. Trusted her.

events.summary: Otharri screams a warning and Neyali realizes Reyana, the rear guard, is missing and races back.
events.quote: Neyali launched into motion before any of her cohorts could answer

events.summary: Neyali finds Reyana cornered by a compleated Auriok aspirant who offers to make her perfect; Reyana is distraught and has dropped her weapons.
events.quote: You are finally ready to be made perfect,

events.summary: Neyali and Otharri attack the aspirant and Neyali throws it over the ledge.
events.quote: The Phyrexian fell without so much as a cry.

events.summary: Reyana reveals the aspirant was her mother.
In the rookery, Reyana finds her clutch dead and confesses she once wished her mother dead and asks, what if Phyrexia is right?
Neyali promises to stay by Reyana's side, but Reyana does not complete their usual call and response.
events.quote: Reyana had not spoken her half of their usual call and response

events.summary: Reyana is gone in the morning, leaving only a note to meet at the Salvage Complex.
events.quote: Meet me at the Salvage Complex.

events.summary: Neyali, Elham, Saheena and her sons set off for the Salvage Complex, finding Mirran camps where loved ones vanished with no sign of force.
events.quote: that loved ones had gone missing, with no signs that they'd been taken by force.

events.summary: They find Reyana shackled in the Salvage Complex's pit among rows of kneeling dead Phyrexians, apparently unguarded.
events.quote: it was Reyana, shackled and prone.

events.summary: Neyali descends with Saheena and her sons, and Reyana frees herself from her chains and is revealed as a willing traitor.
events.quote: Reyana, no longer bound, sat up placidly

events.summary: Reyana says she wants the perfect peace her mother was given, and Slobad appears with an aspirant who is the father of Saheena's son.
Slobad offers to spare the other Mirrans if the four give themselves up, and Neyali bargains for her companions' release.
events.quote: I offer you a choice. You four,

events.summary: Neyali orders Saheena and her sons to go, and Slobad lets them leave, keeping Neyali.
events.quote: True to his word, Slobad and his minions did nothing

events.summary: Neyali is caged above as Slobad himself prepares to compleate Reyana.
events.quote: To Neyali's surprise, it was not a priest who came to begin Reyana's transformation but Slobad himself.

events.summary: Otharri returns and burns the cage bars, freeing Neyali and the other captured Mirrans while an alarm sounds.
events.quote: the firebird's flames incinerated the bars

events.summary: Neyali rallies the freed Mirrans and offers Reyana a hand, but Reyana turns away as Neyali leads her people out.

relations.note: Childhood friends who call each other family; Reyana betrays her.

relations.quote: Watch the skies for me, beloved,

relations.note: Neyali leads the resistance cell after Elham.
relations.quote: she had trusted Neyali to take over when she stepped down.

relations.note: Slobad handles waste disposal for Urabrask.
relations.quote: Urabrask sends obsolete Phyrexians to him for repurposing.

relations.note: Reyana goes to Slobad, hoping for peace and reunion.
relations.quote: Slobad—he promised me that there will be peace.

relations.note: Elham led before Neyali and follows her.
relations.quote: She is family to us, too,
